policies.name: problem-before-code
policies.rule: A project cannot enter build before a problem, target customer, desired outcome, and validation plan exist.

policies.name: no-secrets-in-source
policies.rule: Secrets, private keys, credentials, and production tokens must not be committed to source control.

policies.name: no-unverified-claims
policies.rule: Agents must not claim tests, deployments, integrations, or external facts that were not actually verified.

policies.name: security-by-default
policies.rule: Authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, validation, and auditability are required according to project risk.

policies.name: destructive-change-approval
policies.rule: Destructive production database, infrastructure, data, or security changes require human approval and recovery evidence.

policies.name: evidence-before-transition
policies.rule: Lifecycle transitions require the evidence defined by the destination gate.

policies.name: least-privilege-agents
policies.rule: Agents receive only the tools and permissions required for their assigned task.

policies.name: automation-after-proof
policies.rule: Repeated workflows should be automated only after the manual process is understood and failure modes are known.

policies.name: local-market-fit
policies.rule: For Ghana/Africa-facing products, assumptions about channels, payments, connectivity, trust, and customer behavior must be explicitly validated.

policies.name: cost-aware-ai
policies.rule: AI features must have an estimated cost envelope, fallback behavior, and measurable value before production use.
